name: Lifting Unit
summary: Lifting and conveying equipment for transferring products between workstations at different heights, enabling seamless production line integration.
contentHtml:
The lifting unit is an automated conveying equipment developed by TXAM for seamless production line height transitions.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a servo drive system combined with precision guide rails to achieve smooth product lifting. It is suitable for product transfer between workstations at different heights, enabling seamless production line integration.

Technical Advantages

  • Smooth lifting with high load capacity
  • Automated control for perfect integration with production lines
  • Stable structure with long service life
  • Customizable stroke and load
